description: This line plot illustrates the quantity of four different types of code-related resources—Tutorials, Library Documentation, StackOverflow posts, and GitHub files—as a function of the number of tokens. The x-axis represents the “Number of Tokens,” ranging from 200 to 800 in a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 200. The y-axis represents the count of resources, ranging from 10 to 40 in a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 10. The blue line, representing Tutorials, starts at approximately 23 and rises to about 29. The red line, representing Library Documentation, begins at approximately 27, rises to about 31 near 500 tokens, and then slightly declines to about 28. The green line, representing GitHub files, begins at approximately 28, rises to about 32 near 500 tokens, and then slightly declines to about 30. The yellow line, representing StackOverflow posts, starts at approximately 33, decreases steadily to about 12 at 800 tokens.
